items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson expects QB Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring injury suffered Sunday; MRI Monday morning; will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring as 2022 college injury.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring on scramble; carted off but walked locker room postgame with slight limp.
items.implication: Miss at least 1+ weeks; Tyson Bagent backup.
items.opportunity: CHI WRs (Rome Odunze, DJ Moore if listed, Luther Burden) and RBs see volume with backup QB.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, ruled OUT; X-rays negative, expected to miss time (previously ~1 month for similar injury). Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on final play of first half vs DAL; carted off.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; Marcus Mariota likely starter.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and WAS pass-catchers short-term roles expand if Mariota starts.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision for MNF; Schefter noted trending wrong direction earlier.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, missed practices Fri/Sat; different from prior.
items.implication: If OUT, Davante Adams/Kyren/TE usage spikes; pivot needed for MNF.
items.opportunity: LAR WRs/TEs (Davante Adams) and RBs expand if inactive.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12 yesterday. Through 2 weeks ops 36-12. Sean Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving RB1/lead back in TB; start confidently.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially while AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs speed with Brown out.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI today after stinger; hope is minor injury. He played through it after missing most of first half.
items.why: Stinger on first drive vs TEN; returned with neck roll.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 if minor; monitor MRI.
items.opportunity: If out longer, Kenny Gainwell/Bucky Irving? Wait PHI backs; reverse if IN.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak: Brock Bowers 'close, very close. He looks great' to returning.
items.opportunity: High target share upon return; Michael Mayer handcuff reverse.

items.text: Postgame watchlist: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), Aaron Jones (knee), JK Dobbins (ham), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), etc.
items.implication: Monitor Monday reports/MRIs for Week 3 availability.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups for OUT cases (e.g. Goedert, Dobbins).

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, wore/optimism for flak jacket).
items.why: Optimism from reports; projected in by ETR/Levitan with docks.
items.opportunity: Full or near routes if no further issue; LAC WR hierarchy locked.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman now as beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; not expected to play per ETR.
items.implication: DEN RB committee shifts; Coleman/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backup RBs in DEN.
Increased routes/targets for remaining BAL pass-catchers.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.
items.opportunity: High target volume in PHI offense.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 YPRR this season; only a few WRs worse (Johnston, Dyami Brown, Addison etc).
items.implication: Volume may not translate; fade or lower expectations.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.opportunity: Minimal long-term; SF WR depth if Robinson out.
